newsitem.title: UK: Vickers up as report sees BMW interest.
newsitem.headline: Vickers up as report sees BMW interest.

text.p: Shares in Vickers Plc firmed on Monday, against the declining trend throughout most of the equity market, after renewed reports that Germany's BMW might be interested in a stake in its Rolls-Royce cars unit.
Continuing a rebound from their 28-month low of 168p set July 15, Vickers shares were up 3p at 180 by 1228 GMT in moderate volume of just over one million shares.

A report in the Mail on Sunday said Vickers might be forced to consider BMW taking a stake in Rolls-Royce as a defensive move against a possible GKN Plc bid if sales of new models prove disappointing.
No-one at Vickers was immediately available for comment.
